_comment: Each row needs gameKey and the current source hash; each group needs why.
Matching hashes remove the row from this language pack's translation inventory.
A changed source hash fails validation so the exclusion is reviewed. Translated rows are still served.

exclusion_groups.why: Keep other quest key item names in English. Spanish translates explicitly selected quest items.
Keep descriptions of unselected quest key items in English.
Unused beta labels explicitly marked as not needed.
